items.headline: Price move coincides with 1 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Wide intraday MCP spread: 124% of daily average on 2026-04-25, same day as: YERMARUS TPP unit 2: 800.0 MW affected (~800 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
